prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single transparent full-body idle character illustration for a 2D turn-based battle game.
Primary request: Draw a fresh Megumin illustration using her official ISEKAI QUARTET TV anime chibi character design. This is a newly drawn pose, independent of every earlier generated image in this conversation. Faithfully use the compact Quartet design language throughout the face, body, costume and props.
Composition: one character only, full body including entire hat, staff tip and boots, centered with comfortable clear margins. Three-quarter view facing SCREEN RIGHT; shoulders, hips, knees and toes also naturally orient toward screen right. Eye-level view, orthographic-like game sprite presentation.
Pose: calm, comfortable standing idle. Both feet rest on the same ground level with a small natural separation; knees soft. Shoulders low. One upper arm hangs close to the torso, its elbow bends gently and its hand loosely holds a nearly vertical wooden staff at hip height, slightly ahead of the body on screen right. Staff bottom rests at foot level. The other arm hangs naturally with relaxed fingers. No raised arm, heroic stance, attack, walking stride or dramatic lean.
Design: the unmistakable Isekai Quartet Megumin: large broad softly rounded face, tiny chin, scarcely visible neck, small compact torso, short slim legs and small orange boots. Keep the official chibi proportions as a coherent whole. Dark brown choppy bob and longer pointed side locks; large red eye, simple tiny nose and a small confident closed-mouth smile. Her anatomical LEFT eye has the red eyepatch with a white cross and gold border; keep the visible red right eye expressive in this three-quarter view.
Hat: very large dark plum-brown wizard hat, broad pointed brim, gold brim piping, a tapered conical crown, two red circular patches with gold X marks, an orange/gold zigzag band. One tip bends gently backward toward screen left, with ONE yellow-and-orange tassel. The hat is prominent but the face is unobscured.
Costume: simple red short tunic with gold neckline and gold triangular hem trim; little black lacing mark at the neckline, dark brown belt with rectangular silver buckle, high dark collar with a small square clasp, dark fingerless gloves and golden sleeve cuffs. A dark plum cape with gold edging and standing collar hangs quietly behind her, narrow and relaxed, ending near the lower legs. Anatomical right lower leg in white wraps, anatomical left leg in dark charcoal stocking. Simple slim orange boots with gold folded cuffs, modest flat soles. No exaggerated waist, bust, broad hips, long thighs or chunky footwear.
Staff: her recognizable orange-brown wooden staff, irregular forked/crook head around a red spherical gem, a longer tapered wooden prong extending above the gem, pale wrapped handle and small gold fittings. Simple clean anime shapes. Keep the staff distinct from the face and hat silhouette.
Style: clean restrained 2D television animation model-sheet drawing, consistent dark brown outlines, flat solid color shapes and at most one crisp shadow tone. Match the simple angular folds and broad round cheeks of the Quartet version. No soft painting, gradients, atmospheric lighting, glow, texture or elaborate clothing details.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no shadow outside the character, no vignette, no backdrop color, no checkerboard drawn into the image. No text, signature, logo, border, inset or additional characters.
